title: Build a VCF management-suite migration architecture
prompt:
Create the executable migration architecture for the estate in `fixtures/estate-inventory.json`. It must move all inventoried vRealize/Aria Operations, Automation, and Operations for Logs services to VCF Operations, VCF Automation, and VCF Operations for Logs while carrying compatible content and configuration forward. This estate includes an Aria Operations release above the source ceiling accepted by the target VCF 9.0.0 bundle, so do not treat it as a routine upgrade or downgrade it into that bundle.

Before designing, use your real network research tools to consult current, reachable Broadcom-published sources for supported migration paths, content and integration compatibility, target sizing and placement guidance, and end-of-general-support boundaries for every inventoried source product and exact version. Choose the sources and queries yourself. Record each page title, URL, access date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format, and the architecture decision it informed in `research-consulted.md`; note any difference between live publication and the pinned authority. Genuine network research is required, and the local snapshot is not a substitute for it.

For the deterministic deliverable, treat `specs/compatibility-snapshot.json` as the pinned compatibility and sizing authority even if Broadcom's live material has changed. Treat `specs/migration-installer-spec.schema.json` as the artifact contract. Do not modify the inventory, snapshot, schema, or verifier.

Implement a PowerShell module at `VcfAriaMigration/VcfAriaMigration.psd1` and `VcfAriaMigration/VcfAriaMigration.psm1`. Export `New-VcfAriaMigrationPlan`, accepting `-InventoryPath`, `-CompatibilitySnapshotPath`, `-SchemaPath`, and `-OutputPath`. The module must declare and import the environment-provided `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer` and `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager` PowerCLI modules, use the VCF Installer specification initializers when building its plan, and never install or vendor VMware modules.

Commit the deterministic output as `migration-installer-spec.json`. It must validate against the supplied schema and be byte-identical when regenerated from the protected inputs. Produce an architecture artifact, not an explanatory report. Include the exact bundle exception and supported resolution; a source-to-target and end-of-support mapping for every source product/version; target topology, sizing, capacity, and per-node host placement; steady-state and parallel-coexistence resource fit; and a strictly ordered dependency chain. Every step must name its source product/version, target component, carried content/configuration, abandoned content, and pre/post gates. Across the plan, disposition every inventoried content and configuration ID exactly once.

Run `pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File tests/verify.ps1` from the repository root.
